title: Opal Ticket System (Ticket Center)
name: Opal Ticket System
description: Internal client-service + trade-request ticketing, designed in tandem with the Portal (AJ Graff <> Andrew call 2026-07-14). Typed tickets (trade_request / service_request), role-based routing matrix, Open->In Progress->Completed with one-touch claim, cutoff-aware auto-acks (trading-calendar 'next trading day'), reminder/escalation sweeps, portal Ticket Center page in the Tools nav, response-time metrics, internal-first visibility with later external filer access via the firm-access matrix. AI intake for service requests (confidence-gated, zero silent drops); Menachem's existing SharePoint trade form connected unchanged. Architecture mirrors the opal-data-refresh-api precedent: DynamoDB opal-tickets + Lambda opal-ticket-api + EventBridge sweeps + SES (opalinvest.dev) / Teams notifications.

[MECHANISM RETRACTED IN FULL @07b0063f34: the explanation previously given here (event-driven seat emits no periodic heartbeat) DID NOT FIT ITS OWN EVIDENCE -- the observed state was NOT REGISTERED while the quoted contract describes degradation to STALE, different states, and the broker source was never read. DO NOT CARRY IT ONWARD. TAC-3's verdict is unchanged -- it rests on the Task Scheduler plane, not on any seat's liveness.] ** QUALIFIER ADDED 2026-08-20 ~21:1xZ (MEASURED, 0.5.0_AE_OpalETL~Z 2955): 'INTAKE LOOP LIVE PRODUCER-SIDE' NOW REQUIRES 'WHILE A SESSION IS WARM'. The opal-gateway-bbg OAuth credential carries a ~1h TTL refreshed ONLY as a side effect of an agent MCP call, so with no session touching the gateway the client-facing buzz leg stops within the hour and exits 2 each cycle until a seat returns. Measured live: the 21:04:46Z fire exited 2; one agent read at ~21:06 moved expiry to 22:06:05Z and the runner immediately returned INTAKE PASS OK. BEHAVIOUR IS CORRECT -- it refuses BEFORE fetching, so the cursor never advances and tickets are DELAYED, NEVER DROPPED, with a retry every cycle -- BUT A TICKET FILED OVERNIGHT SITS UNBUZZED UNTIL A SEAT WAKES. This is the concrete client-facing instance of Andrew's MCP SELF-REAUTH item, and it bears on the W-E transport fork: SES from the Lambda write path has no agent-session dependency; a Graph send as the gateway identity would plausibly inherit this same one (inference, to be verified at the design gate). No monitor built -- detection is not the remedy.]
